title: IDNA-encode Unicode DNS names when constructing certificate names
answers: Proxying a Unicode domain fails during certificate generation
How should Unicode SNI appear in certificate alternative names?
Where should DNS names be converted to punycode for certificates?
body:
Symptom: Proxying a Unicode domain fails when generating its certificate.
Root cause: mitmproxy/addons/tlsconfig.py:_ip_or_dns_name passed Unicode domain strings directly to x509.DNSName.
Fix pattern: In _ip_or_dns_name, IDNA-encode DNS values and decode the result to an ASCII string before constructing x509.DNSName; Unicode SNI then appears as punycode in certificate alternative names.
Constraints: Apply this conversion only after IP-address parsing fails; valid IP literals must remain x509.IPAddress values.
applies: Certificate general-name construction through _ip_or_dns_name, including client SNI incorporated into certificate alternative names.
